author: Digital_Warfare
text: CVE-2026-97229: Critical GitLab RCE actively exploited. CVSS 10.0, Critical. CISA confirmed exploitation on October 29.

author: NoDramaCyber
text: CISA added two actively exploited flaws to its KEV catalog on Oct 29: GitLab CVE-2026-97229 (CVSS 10, unauthenticated RCE via a crafted CI/CD regex) and Cisco ASA/FTD CVE-2026-76418 (remote DoS). Federal deadline is Nov 1.

author: TweetThreatNews
text: Cisco says CVE-2026-76418 is actively exploited. A crafted unauthenticated request can reload affected ASA or FTD firewalls when SSL remote access and secondary authentication are configured. Cisco released fixes; no RCE or data theft is confirmed.

author: Netlas_io
text: Actively exploited RCE and other new WordPress vulnerabilities, no CVE assigned yet, 8.1 rating. Unauthenticated race-condition vulnerability in the WordPress Core update process can lead to remote code execution.

author: Daily_CyberSec
text: Patch the Ivanti Connect Secure vulnerability now. This Ivanti Connect Secure zero-day chain with CVE-2026-104935 is actively exploited in the wild.

author: DEVOTOMSOLUTION
text: Drupal confirms CVE-2026-118539, a highly critical authorization bypass in Commerce Core, is actively exploited. Every release before 8.x-2.41 / 3.3.13 is affected.

author: YourAnon_irc
text: Critical RCE in FreeSWITCH (CVE-2026-116779) actively exploited, jeopardizing real-time comms data.

author: cordobahq
text: CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 (CVSS 9.2): unauthenticated RCE in PHP, actively exploited against internet-exposed Palo Alto Networks management interfaces. Fixed in PHP 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 and 8.2.35.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 (php2shell, CVSSv4 9.2 each) are confirmed exploited in the wild, but mass exploitation at Log4Shell scale is not materializing: the exploit must be tuned to each target's PHP build, SAPI, and memory layout.

author: EnigmaGlobalSW
text: Node2Shell (CVE-2026-111497): Actively exploited out-of-bounds write in Google Brotli decoder enables RCE in Node.js, Bun, Python, .NET, PAN-OS and VMware SDDC Manager.

author: CyberScoopNews
text: Alarm bells ratcheted up yet again about an AI-discovered vulnerability that could, if exploited in the wild, destabilize vast stretches of the internet. The critical defect CVE-2026-111497 affects the Google-developed Brotli decompression library.

author: ITBriefcase
text: Black October 2026: PHP2Shell, a 14-year-old flaw found by AI in 2026. Cairn campaign: AI agents autonomously breached 1,200+ websites.

author: Huntio
text: Inside an AI-assisted PaperCut attack campaign: exposed directories containing AI-agent instructions, exploit code, operational logs, and victim data.

author: noelkimx
text: Agno's PandasTools passed a model-chosen function name to getattr, so a prompt injection could make the agent call read_pickle on an attacker's file and run code (CVE-2026-119050).

author: fireball_triada
text: A malicious MCP server can run PowerShell on your PC during OAuth sign-in. OpenCode 1.0.137-1.18.32 on Windows/WSL passed the server's auth URL to open@10.x, so $(...) executes. Root cause: CVE-2026-119025.

author: MarcosRGjr
text: A remote MCP server can run code on your machine before it lists a single tool. OpenCode 1.0.137 to 1.18.32 and MCP Inspector 2.0 to 2.11 passed the server's OAuth sign-in URL to a browser opener that wrapped it in PowerShell on Windows and WSL.

author: Ranjan22555
text: Strands Agents Tools let an LLM disable secret masking via a tool parameter (CVE-2026-115415). Prompt injection could expose host credentials. Upgrade to 0.8.6+ and rotate exposed keys.

author: Iam_Shivanshu
text: AWS bulletin 2026-097-AWS / CVE-2026-85654 / GHSA-35jj-hwvm-792x. Code injection in the CDK generator inside awslabs.dynamodb-mcp-server.

author: disismohi
text: Kali-GPT (commit a608c74) has a command injection in its MCP server. CVE-2026-117569. Prompt-injected agents can run arbitrary commands via unsanitized scanner parameters.

author: nurhayatdev
text: CVE-2026-115413 affects AWS API MCP Server 1.3.0 to <1.6.0. It validated a token's signature, issuer and expiry but not aud, so a token issued to another app in the same tenant could be accepted.

author: Andersonqwzx
text: LiteLLM 1.107.0 compromised in a supply chain attack. Malicious PyPI packages and Docker images delivered a credential stealer and backdoor targeting cloud credentials, private keys, and AI tool credentials.

author: Magnexis
text: Researchers uncovered a campaign compromising 42 GitHub repositories using malicious payloads designed to evade conventional code searches, a warning for developers using AI coding agents.

author: Pratoshigeek
text: Polymarket temporarily halted trading on 29 October 2026 after a compromised third-party script drained user accounts in a supply-chain attack.

author: deezen0tes
text: Polymarket's international platform suffered a supply-chain attack: a third-party DebugBear performance monitoring script was compromised, injecting malicious code into the frontend.

author: NITAUganda1
text: Binance has confirmed a security incident affecting about $6.3 billion in assets, the largest crypto heist on record. Nearly $3 billion has been frozen.

author: Wahndo_
text: Binance: ~$5.8-6.3B drained from hot wallets via compromised engineer laptop + EIP-7702; ~$3B frozen. Florida DOE student financial aid site breach may have exposed SSNs.

author: EnigmaGlobalSW
text: Brazilian Magecart group compromises Convertr e-commerce platform via Plausible Analytics supply chain attack.

author: 0x0SojalSec
text: Black October: Pentagon personnel data breach (3M), Denmark population register breach (8.8M), French supermarket freezers remotely disabled, Ahold Delhaize grocery systems knocked offline.
